The '''TIE lander''' was a large troop [[Transport/Legends|transport]] manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]], based on the design of the [[TIE/sa tactical bomber/Legends|TIE/sa bomber]].<ref name="ITW:OT" />

==Characteristics==
This craft was a scaled-up version of the [[TIE/br boarding shuttle]].<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
The lander had a triple hull, and could carry a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] [[Company/Legends#Stormtroopers|company]].<ref name="ITW:OT" /> This design was reminiscent of the [[Imperial troop transport]].

==History==
The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial garrison base|garrison base]] in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] was equipped with TIE landers.<ref name="ITW:OT" />
As part of [[Lumiya|Shira Brie's]] cover story, her people were said to have been [[Cleansing of Shalyvane|attacked]] by stormtroopers using these transports.<ref name="SW60" />
